last_handoff.result: SESSION_OBJECTIVE: eliminate real-keyboard spatial-navigation instability without changing gameplay physics or world semantics. CHECKPOINT 2: moved high-frequency navigation sensing into the independently rendering browser frame loop while retaining real Playwright keyboard.down/up actuation. The controller now detects hint/target/stall inside requestAnimationFrame, releases the real key, waits one browser frame, then steers from the settled post-release position. No speed, collision, interaction radius, timeout or canonical location behavior changed. CHECKPOINT 3: corrected the stale-Mira regression to establish its NPC precondition through the legal player-facing MOVE control when Mira is scheduled on the square. Playable Candidate backend/Living World and Living World backend/persistence jobs also passed while their browser jobs were still running.
